'''The Hatchery''' was a shop located on [[Market Row]], a commercial corridor of the [[Port Town (Cloud City)/Legends|Port Town]] district of the [[Mining/Legends|mining]] colony of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], which floated in the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. The business sold exotic pets and food animals,<ref name="TJoY" /> and at some point between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Timeframe">The events of ''The Jewel of Yavin'' took place while Lando Calrissian was Baron Administrator of Cloud City, a period which started in 1 ABY and ended in 3 ABY according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> it was run by a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] named [[Tezli Odo]].<ref name="TJoY" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Hatchery first appeared in ''[[The Jewel of Yavin]]'', an adventure module released in [[2014]] for [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' roleplaying game. The shop is listed as a vendor players can purchase goods from, but no specific interactions are listed.
